bioEn: Ludovic was born in Paris. Fascinated with cinema since he was a teenager, he first chose filmmaking and photography. With Simon Bouisson, they form a duo named såndle and, together they directed few projects as : Tokyo Reverse (France TV), Product and Dezoom (Arte)...

Meanwhile, Ludovic is also a photograph, he works for magazines (Purple, Néon...), brands (Adidas, Lacoste...), and he also proposes a photographic journal project called ARAW! for A Roll A Week on which he posts one analogue film per week for three and a half years wich led to one exhibition per year and a collaboration with FAST magazine.

Few years ago, Ludovic decided to go 100 % back to his first love : cinematography. He missed the technical aspect and the sets experiences of being a director of photography. He has worked on the TV show “Stalk” of Simon Buisson, on the feature “Abdelinho” of Hicham Ayouch and on several commercials and music videos.
